sentences.en: The man attacked her with the intention of killing her.
sentences.zh: 那人攻击她是为了杀了她。

sentences.en: To our great disappointment we failed to carry out intention.
sentences.zh: 令我们非常失望的是，我们的计划未能实现。

sentences.en: It has dawned on me that I mistook his intention.
sentences.zh: 我突然意识到自己误解了他的意图。
